text:
maya: Heads-up: planning the "Weekstarter" launch email series tied to next week's benchmark webinar. Need final segment spec, send windows, and subject variants. Quick sync here.

colin: Can we do a split by timezone/engagement? APAC early, NA midday, EMEA evening. Suggest windows: 8am local / 11am local / 4pm local.

evie: Segment table (draft):
```
segment_id,filter_logic,notes
new_trial_5d,trial_started<=5d,high intent
active_engagers_14d,last_open<=14d,trial & oauth users
lapsed_120d,last_engagement>120d,reactivation test
```
Also thinking to exclude anyone who hit "opt-out-news" in last 30d.

ops_bot: Rate limits: daily quota 1.2M, sustained TPS ok but recommend throttles. We'll monitor 4xx/5xx and auto-scale. If SES errors exceed 3% for 5m, failover to backup provider.

maya: Love it. Creative team: provide 3 subject line families. Keep one very punchy, one educational, one curiosity-driven.

sam: Draft subjects: A) "See Redwood inference benchmarks — webinar + quick wins" B) "How to cut token cost by 2x (webinar)" C) "What we learned from 1000 inference runs". Preheaders: "Register + checklist" or "Benchmarks inside".

colin: A/B traffic split: 60/20/20 across A/B/C for engaged users, but switch to even for lapsed_120d. We'll measure signups and watch-to-register ratio.

evie: Drip cadence: send1 -> 48h follow-up -> 5-day reminder -> post-webinar recap. For new_trial_5d shorten to 24h -> 48h.

maya: @colin can you export segments CSV and drop into s3://marketing/weekstarter/segments_export.csv by EOD? Ops will pull from that path.

colin: Uploaded: s3://marketing/weekstarter/segments_export.csv. checksum: md5: d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e

ops_bot: Detected upload. Scheduling send job for 1743888000 (send epoch). Locking 200 concurrent connections, batch size 150, ramp 10m. Failover target: s3://marketing/weekstarter/fallback.csv.

sam: Note on RSVP gating: include a one-question survey in email (use-case + company size). We'll use that to route follow-ups. Mention "Seats limited" to boost register urgency.

evie: Also add campaign UTM params: utm_campaign=weekstarter_launch&utm_source=email&utm_medium=campaign. We'll track in Console.

maya: Final ask: mark the send as a "benchmark" cohort in Console so Optimize can pull later for cost/latency evals. Posting final plan to #marketing now. Thanks all. :rocket:

colin: One more: can ops add a soft pause rule for EMEA after 30m if bounce rate >2.5%?

ops_bot: Rule created: pause-region "EMEA" if bounce_rate>2.5% over 30m.

maya: Perfect. Debrief scheduled Mon 11am PT.
